LanguageData.SDE_LockModeDesc: Prevents colonists from opening the door when it's unpowered.
LanguageData.SDE_InstallVacBarrierDesc: An integrated ultrasonic barrier that prevents depressurization in space. The field compresses air molecules near the threshold, preventing gases from escaping while allowing people to freely travel through it.\n\nRequires {0} gravlite panels.
LanguageData.SDE_VacCheckpointDesc: A basic VacSuit check. Requires a minimum vacuum resistance of {0} to prevent unsuited colonists from wandering into the vacuum of space.\n\nColonists will ignore this checkpoint {1} if both sides are pressurized, or in the event of a catastrophic hull breach.
LanguageData.SDE_SettingStatusDesc: Displays holograms on doors which locked down or have active vac checkpoints
LanguageData.SDE_SettingDraftedBypassDesc: Whether drafted colonists should ignore vacuum checkpoints, because who needs VacSuits after all?
LanguageData.SDE_SettingVacThreshold: Minimum vacuum resistance for Vac Checkpoint: {0}
LanguageData.SDE_SettingVacEstimate: Around {0} of resistance to vacuum exposure, with death in {1}.
LanguageData.SDE_DockingPointDesc: Toggles whether this door is highlighted during gravship placement to assist with landings
